999008199.text: ここが東メンソス……

何回か魔物の襲撃はあったけど、
３隻とも無事に着いてよかったね

localizations.en: We ran into a few monster attacks along the way, but I'm glad all three ships made it here safely.

999008199.text:
見たところ、普通の街って感じね。
入国にも手間取ったりしなかったし

localizations.en: From what I can see, it looks pretty ordinary. Immigration didn't give us any trouble either.

999008199.text: というか、それよりも何よりも！
なんでイェルカたちが一緒にいるの！？

localizations.en: Why are Jelka and Gou with us!?

999008199.text: あー、うん。釣りしてたら偶然釣れちゃって

localizations.en: Uh, about that. We were fishing and accidentally reeled them in.

999008199.text: 怖っ！　どういうこと！？

localizations.en: That sounds terrifying! How does that even work!?

999008199.text: そんなロロナ先生みたいな……

localizations.en: That sounds like something that would happen to Miss Rorona...

999008199.text: それもどういうこと！？

localizations.en: And that's definitely not normal too!?

999008199.text:
海の上で船から追い出すわけにもいかないし、
なんか私たちに協力してくれるっていうし……

localizations.en: We couldn't exactly throw them overboard in the middle of the ocean, and they said they were here to help...

999008199.text:
果ての大陸に向かうというナナたちの任務を支援し
ケイウンでの借りを返す、それだけだ

localizations.en: I'm simply here to support Nana's mission to World's End and repay the debt from Keiun. Nothing more.

999008199.text: 貸しを作った覚えはないんですけど……

localizations.en: I don't remember putting you in our debt though...

999008199.text:
ゴゥは熱い性格だから、治療の恩を返したいのさ。
アタシとしても、お前さんらの生き様に興味が出たんだ

localizations.en: Gou's got a passionate streak—he wants to return the favor for the medical treatment. As for me, I've taken an interest in how you all live.

999008199.text:
生き様に、ねえ……イェルカについては信じたいけど
師匠のこともあるし、シトリンも怪しいし……

localizations.en: How we live...? I want to trust you, Jelka, but with Master August involved, and not to mention that Citrine...

999008199.text: この行動は、父様には知らせていない

そうなの？
てっきりまた師匠の指示かと思ってたけど……

localizations.en: Really? I figured this was another one of his schemes...

999008199.text: ま、本来なら親に話を通すのが筋ってもんだが……

localizations.en: Well, normally we'd run it by them first...

999008199.text:
お前さんたちを見て、少し気が変わったのさ。
アタシらもやりたいようにやってみるかってね

localizations.en: But seeing you all stirred something in me. I figured we'd try doing things our own way for once.

999008199.text:
ということで、色々思うところあるだろうけど……
二人ともこき使ってやってくれない？

localizations.en: So anyway, I know you've all got mixed feelings about this whole arrangement... But could you work them to the bone for me?

999008199.text:
そんな、こき使うだなんて……私、嬉しいです！
ゴゥさんたちともこうして手を取り合えて！

localizations.en: Work them to the bone? I'm just happy they're onboard!

999008199.text: レスナはほんとまっすぐだね

人を信じすぎるから危なっかしいのよ。
……それがいいところでもあるんだけど

localizations.en: You trust people too easily. That makes you vulnerable. That said, it's also one of your strengths.

999008199.text:
でさ、九偉人なら知ってるんじゃないの？
果ての大陸が具体的にどこにあるか、とか

localizations.en: Oh yeah, if you're part of the Miraculous Nine, don't you know where World's End actually is?

999008199.text: うーん……それが実は、アタシらも知らなくてね

localizations.en: Well... truth is, we don't know either.

999008199.text:
実在するのは確かだが、どうやって到達するか、
具体的な手段を、私たちは知らない

localizations.en: We're certain it exists, but we don't know the specific means to reach it.

999008199.text: そうなんですね

私では立場上言えないこともある。疑問点はいずれ、
父様や母様に会った時に直接聞くことだ

localizations.en: There are things I can't say given my position. When you meet Father and Mother, you should direct your questions to them.

999008199.text:
別に知らなくていいわよ。パルメ族の庇護は
受けないって、レスナは決めているんだし

localizations.en: It's not like we need to hear it from you anyway. Resna's already decided not to accept the Palme's protection.

999008199.text:
お前さんたちとアウグストらパルメ族。
今は、上手くいってないけど……

localizations.en: You all and the Palme—August and the rest. Things aren't in the best of places, but...

999008199.text:
互いに歩み寄る助けになれれば、と
アタシは思い始めているのさ

localizations.en: I'm starting to think I could help bridge that gap.

999008199.text:
歩み寄る助け……！
イェルカさん、ありがとうございます

localizations.en: You would do that for us? Thank you, Jelka, we'll be counting on you.

999008199.text: 正式加入ってことかしら。おめでとう二人とも

localizations.en: So it's official then. Welcome onboard, you two.

999008199.text: ナナとまた一緒にいられて、兄は嬉しいぞ！

localizations.en: Your brother is overjoyed to be with you again, Nana!

999008199.text: ただ何か言いたいことがあれば、口は出すからな

localizations.en: That said, if something needs to be said, I won't hesitate to share.

999008199.text: あまりうるさかったら、海に放流しようかしら

localizations.en: If you get on my nerves, I might just throw you overboard.

999008199.text: はっはっは。言うようになったな

localizations.en: Ha ha ha. Look at you, is that how you talk to your brother now?

999008199.text: もう！　また暑苦しい……！

あははっ、じゃあ兄妹水入らずってことで……
アタシたちは早速、情報収集と行きますかねえ

localizations.en: Ahaha, well then, we'll leave you two lovebirds alone... The rest of us should get back to gathering information.

999008199.text: そうだね。ヴァレリアたちは船の見張りをお願い！

localizations.en: Right. Valeria, please keep watch over the ships!

999008199.text: う、うん。任せておいて
賊や魔物が近づいてきたら、返り討ちにしてやろう！

localizations.en: If any bandits or monsters approach, we'll send them packing!
